# C. Royce Watch Co. — Full Website Summary

C. Royce Watch Co. is a collector-focused vintage watch shop located on the second floor of The French Quarter at 3911 N. 10th Street in McAllen, Texas. It serves people from across the Rio Grande Valley, including communities in Hidalgo, Cameron, and Starr counties.

## Services

### Buy vintage watches
C. Royce Watch Co. helps first-time buyers and experienced collectors evaluate vintage watches through details such as proportion, dial condition, case shape, movement, service history, and overall character. Current inventory changes and recent pieces are shared through official social profiles.

### Sell or trade a watch
Owners can discuss selling or trading an individual vintage watch or a broader collection. Helpful supporting items may include boxes, papers, receipts, service records, spare links, straps, and known family or ownership history.

### Vintage watch consignment
Consignment may be appropriate for pieces that benefit from collector-focused presentation and exposure. Suitability depends on the watch, condition, supporting items, current audience, and the owner’s expectations.

### Source a vintage watch
Collectors may ask for help finding a particular reference, era, style, size, or feature set. The sourcing conversation considers condition, originality, replacement parts, polishing, movement condition, provenance, accessories, budget, and intended use.

## Geographic context

The only verified shop location is in McAllen. C. Royce Watch Co. welcomes collectors from McAllen, Mission, Edinburg, Pharr, Weslaco, Harlingen, Brownsville, Rio Grande City, and other Rio Grande Valley communities. City landing pages indicate an area served, not a branch office.

No business hours, prices, telephone number, warranty terms, authentication guarantee, or current inventory should be inferred unless published by C. Royce Watch Co. Inventory is time-sensitive. Contact the shop or review its official social profiles for current information.
